text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Where is Mr. C.B.!
Mr. C.B. is charging up
from the rear!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: OOOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Ace.
Do you ever feel this way sometimes?”

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I found myself wishing that this moment could last forever.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —I don't think so.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Because then, there wouldn't be a clear winner or loser, right?
I hate that kind of thing.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "...Deep down, you don't even believe that yourself."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Because we're running a 'race.'
—Right?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. You're right.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...That's why I love running with you, Ace.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: ――Across the finish line!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...I think I can finally... come to terms with it—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: That I finally became... an equal to you...!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
Even though that was the plan from the very start...—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Seriously... at long last.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, today, maybe I should speak first.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Enter the Japan Cup, Ace.
There, you and I will—settle this.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The first victory for a Japanese Umamusume...
Let's make sure one of us takes it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! I like that! It's the best!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Well then, I'll win and proudly introduce myself to the whole world right there!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Japan's "Ace,"
Katsuragi Ace, is right here!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nice.
——I'm getting seriously pumped...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: When did Mr. C.B. and Katsuragi Ace become so evenly matched!? What an incredible race...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, they've always been running together.
I see... So those two really are rivals.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...So it comes to this.
Unless I defeat both of you, this path of mine will surely hold no meaning...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Then let us venture forth.
To the steepest stage, with heads held high—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —A few days later, a massive surge began to emerge in the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It all started with an emergency press conference held by Symboli Rudolf, who had conquered the Kikuka Sho to become an undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"—So your next race will be
the Japan Cup rather than the Arima Kinen!?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I wish to claim that first crown
for Japanese Umamusume with my own hands.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: "This is an extremely quick turnaround from the recent Kikuka Sho, but what are your chances of winning...?!"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am fully aware that this will be a fierce battle. I understand it to be a stage where the greatest Umamusume of our era gather.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“—However, I will win.
As one who aspires to be the peerless ‘Emperor,’
I will prevail no matter who the opponent is.”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"And I dedicate this victory...
To guiding all Umamusume to happiness."

text_block_list.name: Public Reaction
text_block_list.text:
"Uoooooh, it's finally here!!
Mr. C.B. vs. Symboli Rudolf!!
I've been waiting for this matchup forever!!"

text_block_list.name: Public Reaction
text_block_list.text: "CB versus Rudolf, plus the chance to witness Japan's first-ever Japan Cup victory... There's way too much to look forward to!! Insane!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf's declaration to enter the Japan Cup
stirred up the public like never before."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, that feverish “swell” inevitably
began closing in on Katsuragi Ace as well—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—Well then, let me hear it.
Your interesting story.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Even so, there's really only one topic the three of us have in common right now, isn't there?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just as you suspected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. Katsuragi Ace.
Allow me to say this to the two of you once more.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I, Symboli Rudolf,
shall face you all
in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
“And in that race, by overthrowing you who run ahead,
I shall carve open a path to becoming the 'Emperor.'”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...You may think of it as unrefined, and that is fine.
However, I have found meaning in defeating both of you at the same time.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Walking on eggshells around us?
—Haha, now that's just plain tasteless."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
A "race" can never be too fierce.
In fact, bring it on. —Right, Ace?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah. It's not often you get the chance to face an undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume and the great Mr. C.B. at the same time, after all.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If I win this Japan Cup,
I'll be Japan's "Ace" in both name and reality!
How could I not be fired up...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Just as expected.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Then let us devour one another to our hearts' content.
Quite literally, with body and soul—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the Japan Cup shaped up to be a three-way showdown, and together with Katsuragi Ace, I tried to devise a counter-strategy against Symboli Rudolf, but—

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Diving through the inside is Symboli Rudolf!
Passing the 200-meter mark to the finish!!
Here comes Symboli Rudolf!!!"

text_block_list.name: TV Audio
text_block_list.text:
"Symboli Rudolf takes the lead!!
Symboli Rudolf crosses the line!!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"……Seeing it again, it's seriously insane.
Even through the screen, the pressure is unreal……"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Guess being an undefeated Triple Crown Umamusume isn't just for show. ...There's not a single opening in anything she does.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The more I research, the more
Symboli Rudolf's extraordinary, off-the-charts strength
becomes starkly evident.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This time, on top of Symboli Rudolf, she has to face top-class Umamusume from overseas and Mr. C.B. all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Without a doubt, this will be the toughest battle
yet for Katsuragi Ace.
Yet, time waits for no one—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —WOOOOAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Here comes Symboli Rudolf!
Mr. C.B. is moving up as well!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Oh! Has Katsuragi Ace completely run out of steam here?!
She is rapidly fading to the back of the pack—!!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Dammit...! To hell with this!!
Waaaaaaahhhhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Haaah...!
Haaah...! Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Dammit... Having nightmares...
How pathetic...)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
(Still... the truth is, right now...
I can't see any kind of vision where I beat both Rudolf and C.B. at the same time...――)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: (I've got more than enough fight in me...! But the rational part of my brain is buzzing with unease...!)

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Dammit...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —*Pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"No good, they'll catch me at this rate...!
I gotta do something more...!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As the Japan Cup drew near, Katsuragi Ace was showing clear signs of impatience during training...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even so, I still haven't found a surefire strategy to resolve it within myself.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
No matter how small, is there a breakthrough to change the situation, a path to victory?
As I desperately search for one—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text:
“—Hello, thank you for taking care of her.
I'm Katsuragi Ace's mother.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The person calling me through the academy
was none other than Katsuragi Ace's mother...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, Trainer, there's something
I'd like to consult with you about... or rather, a favor I have to ask."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Leading up to the Japan Cup,
a certain wager was about to be set in motion—
